stories.title: Trump annuncia l’intesa: “Tregua energetica tra Russia e Ucraina, subito in vigore”

en.title: Trump announces agreement: "Energy truce between Russia and Ukraine, effective immediately"
en.summary: Trump declared on Truth Social that both Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy ceasefire, but Zelensky stated Ukraine was not informed and reported Russian attacks on power infrastructure after the announcement. Moscow has not yet confirmed acceptance.

stories.title: Kolo Muani tiene a galla la Juventus: 1-1 a Cagliari

en.title: Kolo Muani keeps Juventus afloat: 1-1 draw with Cagliari
en.summary: Kolo Muani scored for Juventus to equalize against Cagliari's Maldini goal, despite some missed chances. A confrontation between coaches Spalletti and Pisacane occurred after the match.

stories.title: Trump: “Tregua energetica”, ma Mosca smentisce. Sospeso il viaggio in Russia di Witkoff e Kushner

en.title: Trump: "Energy truce", but Moscow denies. Witkoff and Kushner's Russia trip suspended
en.summary: Trump announced an energy ceasefire, but the Ukrainian president stated he was uninformed and accused Russia of striking a power plant following the announcement. Moscow has not confirmed the agreement.

stories.title: Reggio Children, bufera sulla richiesta agli educatori ebrei. Meghnagi: “Metodi da Terzo Reich”

en.title: Reggio Children uproar over request to Jewish educators. Meghnagi: "Methods from the Third Reich"
en.summary: The president of Milan's Jewish community accused the Reggio Children organization of discrimination after it requested Jewish teachers to sign a statement disassociating themselves from Israeli government actions.

stories.title: Ucraina, Trump punta sulla tregua energetica per abbassare il prezzo del gasolio

en.title: Ukraine: Trump targets energy truce to lower diesel prices
en.summary: Witkoff and Kushner reportedly offered Moscow incentives to halt attacks on Kyiv's electrical and heating infrastructure. The initiative comes amid considerations related to American midterm elections.

stories.title: È morta Wilma De Angelis, aveva 96 anni

en.title: Wilma De Angelis has died, she was 96 years old
en.summary: Wilma De Angelis, born in Milan in 1930, passed away at age 96. She had a career spanning over 70 years working in light music and television.

stories.title: I due messaggi di Papa Leone nell'annuncio della sua malattia

en.title: Pope Leo's two messages in the announcement of his illness
en.summary: Pope Leo conveyed two messages through his announcement of illness: how a Christian approaches disease, and that the papal court maintains transparency rather than secrecy to avoid gossip.

stories.title: Wilma De Angelis, la cantante morta a 96 anni. E’ stata pioniera dei programmi di cucina in tv

en.title: Wilma De Angelis, the singer who died at 96. She was a pioneer of cooking shows on television
en.summary: Wilma De Angelis, a singer who died at 96, was a pioneer in television cooking programs. Her death was announced by her nephew on Facebook.

en.title: Wilma De Angelis has died
en.summary: Wilma De Angelis, a singer, actress, and television host, has died at age 96.

stories.title: Il nodulo, il viaggio e quelle nomine dei vertici vaticani: cosa c’è dietro l’annuncio del Papa

en.title: The Nodule, the Journey and Those Vatican Leadership Appointments: What's Behind the Pope's Announcement
en.summary: The Pope announced health developments using a conversational tone and confirmed his planned trip to South America beginning November 6. Vatican leadership appointments were made in connection with the announcement.

stories.title: «Ho un nodulo al polmone», l'annuncio di Papa Leone XIV durante l'Angelus gela Piazza San Pietro

en.title: "I Have a Lung Nodule," Pope Leo XIV's Announcement During Angelus Stuns St. Peter's Square
en.summary: Pope Leo XIV announced during the Angelus that he has a lung nodule and will undergo surgery in the coming days. The Pontiff stated the nodule was detected in an early and well-localized phase.

stories.title: “A Reggio Emilia metodi da Terzo Reich”: cento educatori ebrei rinunciano al viaggio

en.title: "Third Reich methods at Reggio Emilia": hundred Jewish educators cancel trip
en.summary: About one hundred Jewish educators withdrew from a planned visit after organisers required them to condemn Gaza's occupation, prompting criticism from Milan's Jewish community leader.

stories.title: Fibra ottica, l’odissea delle attivazioni: la rete c’è, ma gli utenti restano al palo

en.title: Fiber optic activation ordeal: the network exists, but users remain stranded
en.summary: Fiber optic infrastructure is deployed in various locations, yet customers requesting faster and more stable connections for streaming and work face delays in service activation.

stories.title: Liguria, la Regione rafforza gli investimenti sugli Its

en.title: Liguria, the Region strengthens investments in its technical institutes
en.summary: The Liguria region allocated 6.73 million euros to technical institutes and 6.34 million euros to support employment for people with disabilities.

stories.title: La milanese Medisolve rileva l’austriaca Mides

en.title: Milan-based Medisolve acquires Austrian Mides
en.summary: Medisolve, a Milan-based company backed by private equity firm HIG Capital and a European leader in biomedical equipment management and maintenance services, has acquired Mides.

stories.title: Caccia ai talenti dell’AI: quanto costano e quanto rendono alle imprese italiane

en.title: Hunting for AI talent: costs and returns for Italian companies
en.summary: Italian companies specializing in artificial intelligence are willing to pay significantly more for personnel compared to similar companies, seeking young talent with AI expertise.

stories.title: Ex Ilva: «Stop per l’ordine dei giudici e perché siamo senza materie prime»

en.title: Ex Ilva: "Stoppage due to court order and lack of raw materials"
en.summary: The company cited unrealistic conditions imposed by magistrates within 90 days and stated it halted purchasing for production due to anticipated plant closure.
